subject: Walled-network architecture review — scheduling
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@novaplace.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops-team@novaplace.com
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Walled-network architecture review — request to schedule

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick notes on the private deployment options earlier this week. Our infra team would like a focused architecture review that covers VPC peering, NAT/egress constraints, and air-gap/transport controls before we move to an onboarding POC.

Proposed goals for the session (60–75m):
- Confirm minimum network topology and firewall rules for an air-gapped on-prem setup
- Discuss KMS/HSM integration and key rotation patterns
- Walk through KV cache persistence and expected storage/backup needs
- Identify any red flags for our compliance team (data residency, audit logs)

We can be flexible with times, but ideally the week of Apr 3. Attachment: network-draft.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB) — a rough sketch from our architects.

Who should we expect on your side? If you can propose two slots (one in PST morning, one in PST afternoon) that would help.

Thanks,
Sarah Kim
Head of Platform, Novaplace
[sarah.kim@novaplace.com]

--
Novaplace — Platform & Infrastructure

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear agenda and the sketch, that helps a lot. Mina (SE) will lead the technical deep-dive and I’ll have Lauren join for any procurement/next-steps questions.

Two slots that work for our infra team next week (all PT):
- Tue Apr 4, 09:30–10:45 PT (60–75m) — morning slot
- Wed Apr 5, 15:00–16:15 PT (60–75m) — afternoon slot

If neither works, propose two windows that do and we’ll try to accommodate. For the air-gapped discussion we recommend Mina share a one-page checklist in advance — I’ll attach our private-deploy-checklist.xlsx and a short one-pager on Redwood capabilities so your compliance folks have context.

Attachments: private-deploy-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 42KB); redwood-capabilities-onepager.pdf (PDF, 180KB)

Marcus — thanks. Wed Apr 5, 15:00–16:15 PT works for most of our folks. Two quick asks before we lock: 
1) Can Mina confirm whether the session will include a brief break-out for our ops engineers to review port/egress rules live (we expect two folks to drop into a separate call if helpful)?
2) Our on-prem ops lead (ops-team@novaplace.com) asked whether Redwood has a recommended timeframe for a staged cutover during a POC (approx. how many days from initial install to validation for an air-gapped minimal setup). No need for exact numbers — ballpark is fine.

We’ll accept the Wed slot pending those clarifications.

On a side note: timezone for the invite — please send as PT/PST so our contractors don’t get routed into the wrong zone.

Thanks — Sarah

Hi Sarah — confirmed for Wed Apr 5, 15:00–16:15 PT. I’ll run the deep-dive and we’ll carve out ~15 minutes mid-call for an ops break-out so your on-prem engineers can validate firewall/port specifics.

A quick answer to your staged cutover question: for a minimal air-gapped POC we typically expect 3–7 business days for an infra team that already has server provisioning and network ACLs in place. That includes install, basic integration (KMS binding and metrics collection), and a short validation window. If you need a tighter estimate we can map a mutual action plan during the call.

Meeting invite sent: https://meet.google.com/xyz-abcq-123 (calendar will show PT). I also uploaded the checklist and the one-pager to the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_private-deploy-resources

See you Wed — Mina
